name: DIO Corporation
summary: Based in South Korea, DIO Corporation is a key player in the manufacturing and distribution of dental implants. Its extensive range of implant systems includes UFII internal (both submerged and non-submerged), FTN external, and protem mini systems. The company further provides UV active components, activators, and essential instrument kits. In addition to dental implants, DIO offers dental digital solutions, a variety of dental products, and cardiovascular medical devices. Its global reach extends to approximately 70 countries through its export activities. The firm, which was founded in 1988, was initially known as DSI Co., Ltd before rebranding as DIO Corporation in August 2008. It is headquartered in Busan, South Korea.
